items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I remember one Sunday, this must have been about two o'clock, our band and Rene met there on Roman Street.

ctx.x: And what would you play on your trombone as an accompaniment to? Did you use loops in your trombone?

Sometimes, no I never didn't use that. I'd put a mat, put a derby, or a hat over my arms, and play behind it. He was a good street man. In them days used to have some advertising. You get out on the street with a truck, you better be right. Don't a guy run you all over town. I remember one Sunday, this must have been about two o'clock, our band and Rene met there on Roman Street. We stayed there from two until after five.
